title: Hera spacecraft gets 1st up-close look at stadium-sized hole punched in asteroid by NASA DART mission
caption:
The first up-close look at the aftermath of NASA's DART impact. Hera shows us that hitting an asteroid doesn't just move it—it changes it forever.
